full_prompt_en: A square painting presents a crowded yet airy interior built from loose, overlapping blocks of color. In the foreground, a small round table stands slightly left of center on slender dark legs. A pale blue bowl and a translucent yellow vessel rest on its dark green top. To the right, an orange wooden chair with a thin frame and a rounded seat turns diagonally toward the viewer; its back rises into a pale pink and gray patchwork of wall and furniture. Another soft yellow-green chair occupies the left side, partly obscured by the table and by a dark green vertical rectangle. In the rear, fragments of doorways, windows, frames, and indistinct furniture create a shallow domestic space without resolving into precise perspective. The palette moves between milky white, pale blue, muted sage, peach, terracotta, mustard yellow, pink, and occasional nearly black accents. Broad dry brushstrokes and scraped patches overlap thinner pencil-like contours. Some objects are first drawn as looping, searching lines and then partially covered by opaque paint; others emerge only where neighboring colors meet. Orange curves repeat between the chair, background shapes, and a rounded form under its seat. The upper region stays relatively light and open, while dark accents hold the busy arrangement together. Edges wobble and break, leaving small glimpses of earlier marks visible. There is no readable text and no figure. The image feels observational but deliberately unresolved, finding rhythm in ordinary furnishings through asymmetrical balance, revised outlines, and the contrast between transparent sketch and thick paint.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画用松散重叠的色块呈现拥挤却透气的室内。前景中央偏左立着一张细深色桌腿的小圆桌，深绿色桌面上有浅蓝碗和透明感的黄容器。右侧一把细框橙色木椅以斜角朝观者转来，圆润椅面上方的靠背升入淡粉与灰色墙面、家具的拼块。另一把柔和黄绿色椅子占据左侧，被桌子和深绿色竖形局部遮住。后方门洞、窗、画框及不明家具的碎片形成浅浅居家空间，却不落实为精确透视。色板在乳白、淡蓝、低饱和鼠尾草绿、桃色、赤陶、芥末黄、粉色与少量近黑重音之间游走。宽阔干笔与刮擦色块覆盖较细的铅笔般轮廓。有些物件先以弯曲试探线画出，再被不透明颜料部分盖住；另一些仅在相邻色面交界处显形。橙色曲线在椅子、背景形状和座下圆形间重复。上方相对轻亮开放，深色重音维系忙碌结构。边缘摇摆断开，留出早先笔迹的小片痕迹。没有可读文字或人物。画面带观察感却有意不完全定型，以不对称平衡、修订轮廓以及透明速写与厚颜料的对比，从日常陈设中提炼节律。
style_prompt_en: Use loose, revision-rich painting with broad opaque color patches interleaved with thin searching contours. Build forms through overlap, partial erasure, and visible earlier decisions, letting some edges dissolve while others are reinforced by dark lines. Favor a light, varied palette of milky white, pale blue, sage, peach, terracotta, mustard, and soft pink, anchored by small near-black accents. Keep perspective shallow and slightly unstable so the composition reads as a rhythmic arrangement of shapes. Alternate dry scraped texture, flat filled areas, and translucent marks. Balance an airy upper field with denser interlocking forms below. The effect is playful, observational, and intentionally open, preserving the energy of adjustment rather than a polished final contour.
style_prompt_zh: 采用松散且保留修订痕迹的绘画，让宽阔不透明色块与细细试探轮廓交错。通过重叠、局部擦除和可见的早期决定建立形体，让部分边缘消散，部分则由深线加固。使用乳白、淡蓝、鼠尾草绿、桃色、赤陶、芥末黄和柔粉组成明亮多变色板，辅以少量近黑重音。透视保持浅且略不稳定，使构图读作有节律的形状排列。交替使用干擦肌理、平涂区域和透明笔迹。以透气上部平衡下方更密的互锁形体。效果活泼、观察性强且有意开放，保留调整过程的能量，而非抛光完成的轮廓。
theme_en: Two chairs and a small round table in a loosely painted interior
theme_zh: 松散笔触室内中的两把椅子和一张小圆桌
name: Amy Sillman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
